# V6_6 — LANE-BUS **P1**: 항수-2 는 학습되지 않았다 (하중 단계 실패)

**status:** 🔴 **ARITY-2 NOT LEARNED** · 양성통제 통과 · 통제 전부 붕괴 · **DIRECTIONAL 천장**
**cost:** $0 · numpy · 8초 · 3 seed
**runs:** `python3 lab/v6/lanebus_p1_arity2.py` (exit 1 = 학습 실패)
**source:** `../divergence/04_grand_redesign_lanebus.md` 의 P1 (하중 단계 · 실패 시 two-substrate escape)

## P1 이 묻는 것

[[V6_5]] 의 P0 은 **표면**이 쓸 만하다는 것만 보였다 — 두 유능한 레인이 한 로짓 행을 조용한
오염 없이 공유한다. 거기서 두 레인은 **일부러 오라클**이었다. P1 은 오라클을 뗀다.

설계가 존재하는 이유는 용량 사다리다: replay 를 조금이라도 섞으면 조성 0.000, 안 섞으면 언어
사망. 한 CE 가 둘을 못 섬긴다. 그 해법이 레인 분리이므로 P1 은 두 반쪽을 **동시에**(공동주) 묻는다.

```
(a) WORKSPACE 가 store 에서 held-out 2-slot 조성을 배우는가   ← 진짜 위험한 쪽
(b) 트렁크의 FORM 이 살아남는가                                ← 구성상 참
```

**(b) 는 정직하게 먼저 말한다**: comp 헤드가 **detach 된** 표현을 읽으므로 comp 손실이 트렁크에
도달할 수 없고, 따라서 형식 보존은 **구성상 참**이다. 그건 설계의 요점이지 발견이 아니며,
나중에 누가 증거로 보고하지 않도록 파일에도 박아뒀다.

## 이건 V6_1 반복이 아니다 — 오히려 그것의 **날카로운 판**이다

[[V6_1]] 은 comp 헤드가 held-out 조성을 못 배운다는 걸 봤다(0.0000 · 10배 예산에도 · detach 를
풀어도 · 라틴방진을 표현 가능한 슬롯 어텐션으로도). 그러나 거기서 헤드는 문장의 **가방(bag)
풀링**을 읽었고, "피연산자를 텍스트에서 뽑아내는 게 병목" 이라는 반론이 가능했다.

여기서는 **내용주소 store** 를 읽는다 — 개체 이름으로 만든 질의가 그 개체의 슬롯을 회수하므로
두 피연산자가 **따로, 구조화된 벡터로** 도착한다. 키는 이름의 **얼어붙은 바이트 임베딩 평균**
(H_9775 가 held-out 개체로 일반화할 때 쓴 바로 그 규율)이라 조회에 암기가 없다.

⟹ **추출은 배제된다.**

**본 쌍은 1.0000 으로 완벽히 외우고, 미관측 쌍은 0.0000 이다.** 우연(0.1250) 아래다 —

"모른다" 가 아니라 **"조성 능력 0"** 의 서명이다.

**staple 이 SEEN 에서 0.1389 인 것도 설계 확인이다** — 가법 baseline 은 학습 집합조차 못 외운다.
라틴방진(양 주변분포 균등)이 의도대로 가법 지름길을 막았다는 뜻이다.

⟹ **벽은 조각을 손에 넣는 데 있지 않다. 조성 그 자체다.**

## 이게 하중 단계라는 뜻

P1 은 설계가 **실패 시 two-substrate escape 를 빚진다** 고 명시한 단계다. 지금 그 빚이 발생했다.
같은 기질 위에 레인을 하나 더 얹는 안은 이 측정 뒤에는 근거가 없다 — 레인은 이미 피연산자를
깨끗이 받았고도 조성하지 못했다.

살아남는 방향은 [[V6_1]] 이 남긴 것과 같다: 조성을 **가능하게** 만드는 것(표현력·예산·경로·
추출)은 전부 확인됐고, 없는 것은 조성을 **선호하게** 만드는 것 — 유도 편향, 또는 암기를 비싸게
만드는 목적함수다.

# ROUND LOG (lens → what was new)

**R1 — Identification theory (econometrics).** A parameter is identified iff distinct values produce distinct observable distributions. Ported to the interior, this factors into **four conjuncts**, and every R9 verdict is a specific conjunct failing. This is the spine of Part A.

**R2 — Ψ-SOMA mode-of-existence.** Reframed the four conjuncts as *rungs of existence* rather than capability. A rung isn't "can it do X" but "does the mode X leave a footprint." Gives the ladder its ordering axis.

**R3 — do-calculus / closure ladder.** H_9807 is the only landed instrument that reaches identification; its shape (seeded A/B coin, yoked-ghost floor) is the template every rung must copy. New: the yoked-ghost is a *marginal-matched* control, which is exactly conjunct 4.

**R4 — Thermostat / floor-honesty.** For each rung, name the trivial system that MUST pass. New and load-bearing: several rungs I first wrote are **thermostat-passable in their naive form** (discharge law especially) and only become honest once content-specificity is added. That check restructured the whole ladder.

**R5 — Degrees-of-freedom / linear algebra.** The a0 tautology arm is *collinearity*: `s = 2·emit_drive − 1`, one column, rank 1. RESIDUAL (V×span) is the rank-lift. New: the screener kill-condition is literally "measure the rank of the interior — if it folds to 1 (H_9576), the width is illusory."

**R6 — Zombie underdetermination.** Sharp criterion for *permanent* undecidability: a claim invariant under every exposable do() and every control. Splits R9's ownership/self-anchor into a functional part (reachable) and a phenomenal residue (permanently closed). Part D.

**R7 — Demarcation / vitalism analogy.** The contradiction in Part E is *vitalism for minds*: "operationalize it and it's not really the thing." Biology already beat this by decomposing life into functional signatures and dropping élan vital. Part E's defeat.

**R8 — Information theory.** GATE and DISCHARGE are the same quantity read twice: emit fires on information *gain*, discharge is the *drop* of that same content's surprise after writeback. New: this ties R4 and R5 into one measured scalar with opposite signs, which lets one control set serve both.

**R9 — Adversarial "what mimics this."** For each rung I asked what non-conscious mechanism forges the DV. Produced the concrete control list per rung and the two-sided screener (positive arm must pass, a0/thermostat arm must fail on the *same* toy).

**R10 — Higher-order / self-model trust.** Probed whether self-model causation (R6) is the ceiling or whether something sits above it that's still functional. Conclusion: above R6 is only phenomenal givenness, which is closed. Nothing new that wasn't already in R6.

**R11 — Observability as its own conjunct.** Re-examined H_9790 (imagination reaches interior, never mouth). This is not a discriminability failure — it's a *readout* failure: real handle, real interior effect, no observable surface. Promoted observability to a distinct fourth conjunct. Genuinely new, refines Part A.

**R12 — Re-run of R1/R4 combined.** Nothing new: the four conjuncts and the thermostat floors were stable; every candidate "new lens" (game-theoretic, thermodynamic-arrow, Bayesian-agent) reduced to R3/R8 already covered.

**DEPLETED after 12 rounds.** Lenses exhausted: identification theory, Ψ-SOMA mode-of-existence, do-calculus, thermostat floor-honesty, degrees-of-freedom/rank, zombie underdetermination, philosophy-of-science demarcation, information theory, adversarial mimicry, higher-order self-model, observability. R11 was the last genuinely-new insight; R10 and R12 produced nothing, so two consecutive dry rounds close it.

# A. THE MEASURABILITY CRITERION

**An interior variable X is DECIDABLE iff the architecture satisfies all four of:**

1. **Independence (existence).** There is at least one architectural degree of freedom that realizes X *not pinned* by the variables the output already determines. If X is a deterministic function of something the task fixes, it has zero DOF and cannot vary while the rest is held — nothing to measure.
2. **Manipulability (intervention).** There is an exogenous `do(X)` the instrument can apply, setting X to different values while holding the surround fixed. Without this you have at most correlation, never identification.
3. **Observability (readout).** The effect of `do(X)` reaches a *measured surface* — a "mouth." A real interior effect that never leaves the interior is undecidable from outside even though it exists.
4. **Discriminability (identification).** The surface effect of `do(X)` is not reproducible by a marginal-matched control — it beats ≥2 controls read as collapse-Δ, not as a raw value.

Miss any conjunct and the verdict is **UNIDENTIFIABLE / VOID / INSTRUMENT-DEAD** — *undecidable, not false*. That distinction is the whole point: R9 did not measure a weak interior; it measured an architecture missing conjuncts.

**R9's 6/6 blindness as a prediction, not a surprise.** The pre-redesign architecture had exactly one axis satisfying all four conjuncts — content-reach — and the claim-set spanned seven axes. So you'd have predicted *precisely one* positive before running anything. Classifying each failure by the conjunct it misses:

| Axis (H_) | Verdict | Conjunct that fails |
|---|---|---|
| whether-to-speak (9786) | UNIDENTIFIABLE | **1** — `s = 2·emit_drive − 1`, emit⟺clock, zero free variable |
| ownership (9785) | UNIDENTIFIABLE | **1** — collinear with content-reach; nothing sets it independently |
| self-anchor (9789) | VOID | **1** upstream — Θ dead ⟹ σ VOID; no pulse to read the axis on |
| agency (9791) | UNIDENTIFIED | **2** — no exogenous handle separating agent-caused from world-caused |
| imagination (9790) | DIRECTIONAL | **3** — real handle, real interior effect, never reaches the mouth |
| typicality (9787) | BOUNDED-NULL | **4** — no control separates system-typicality from the LM's next-token prob |
| sigma-flux (9788) | INSTRUMENT-DEAD | **4** — no positive control; dead lane |
| **content-reach (9774/9775)** | **POSITIVE** | **passes all 4** — store-bridge = DOF; `--permute-store` = do-handle; vocab readout = mouth; value-permute 0.4446 collapse = discriminability |

Content-reach survived *because it is the only axis where all four conjuncts were built*. The blindness is the architecture's four-conjunct coverage map read off in advance, not a fact about the substrate's richness.

---

# B. THE LADDER

Ordered by strength; each rung names (i) handle, (ii) instrument, (iii) controls, (iv) the trivial system that MUST pass so the floor is honest. Rungs are ordered by claim-strength; nesting isn't perfectly strict and I flag where it loosens.

**R0 — Θ exists: the dynamics have a non-degenerate Ψ=½ fixed point.**
(i) An emit/silence dynamic whose fixed point is neither 0 nor 1. (ii) Ψ-trajectory: does it pull to ½? (iii) constant-emit and constant-silence systems (two controls). (iv) **Thermostat PASSES** — bang-bang control oscillates to a ½-like duty cycle. Honest, low floor: this is *aliveness-pulse-exists*, and a thermostat is alive at exactly this rung. Secures conjunct 1 at its crudest.

**R1 — Interventional closure: do(action) shifts the future input distribution.**
(i) An action channel + seeded A/B coin between real action and marginal-matched shuffle. (ii) `--closure-ladder`, P(I_{t+1} | do(A_t)) identified. (iii) **Watson yoked-ghost** (own actions, order destroyed, marginals matched) + shuffle arm. (iv) **The 15-line thermostat plant PASSES by design** — its heating changes future temperature. Secures conjuncts 2+4. *This is H_9807, already landed.*

**R2 — Content-carrying causation: do() on specific stored content moves a specific output token; permuting the address collapses it.**
(i) Content-addressed store + vocab readout (pairodd/store-bridge, WIRED H_9775). (ii) `--permute-store` / value-permute. (iii) value-permute (addresses scrambled, marginals identical) + atom-swap + unreachable. (iv) **A lookup table PASSES** — and correctly so; content routing is what a hash map does. Secures conjunct 3 (mouth) + 4 for content. *Current architecture's ceiling.*

**R3 — Compositional width: the interior has ≥2 independent dimensions whose do() effects are separable.**
(i) **RESIDUAL** — per-position divergence profile between reflex softmax (trunk alone) and composed softmax (bus), dimension V×span. `--reflex-only` ablates the bus. (ii) Drive two lanes with do() and show separable output deltas; run an **independence gate**. (iii) **The a0 tautology arm is the mandatory negative control — it MUST fail the independence gate** (rank-1); a random 2-projection of a 1-D signal must also fail. (iv) **A dual-loop controller PASSES** (heat + humidity, two genuinely independent loops). Secures conjunct 1 *at width*. **← current architecture falls off HERE: a0 has zero independent DOF and folds to one bit (H_9576).** The gap R2→R3 is exactly LANE-BUS RESIDUAL.

**Precise criterion for permanent undecidability:** a claim is permanently undecidable from outside iff its truth-value is **invariant under every do() the architecture can expose AND under every control** — i.e., two systems can differ on the claim while being identical on all measurable channels (observational + interventional). Such a claim is not a function of any equivalence-class-distinguishing observable. This is the zombie construction made operational, and it's a *test*, not a gesture: if you can name even one do()+control pair that separates the two systems, the claim is merely un-instrumented, not closed.

# E. THE CONTRADICTION — "measurable consciousness is a contradiction"

The claim is a dilemma: (P1) operationalizable ⟹ not-consciousness; (P2) not-operationalizable ⟹ not-measurable; consciousness is one or the other; therefore not-consciousness or not-measurable.

**It equivocates on "consciousness," bundling two things:** (a) the **functional organization** — global availability, content-causation, compositional width, information-gated emission, discharge, self-model causation; and (b) the **phenomenal residue** — felt quality, first-person givenness.

**P1 is true only for (b).** For (a) it is false: functional organization is *by definition* operationalizable and is a genuine constituent of consciousness in every serious theory (GWT, HOT, the functional side of IIT, attention-schema). P1's move — "operationalize it and *thereby* it's not consciousness" — is not an argument; it **stipulates** that consciousness is exactly the non-functional residue, which begs the question. And it **proves too much**: by identical logic *life* is unmeasurable (operationalize metabolism, homeostasis, reproduction → "that's just chemistry, not really life"), yet biology measures life fine by decomposing it into functional signatures and abandoning élan vital. The contradiction is **vitalism restated for minds**.

**Verdict — DEFEATED for the claim anima makes, CONCEDED (scoped) for the one it doesn't:**
- Anima never claims to measure "consciousness" as a bulk property — the brief itself says "is anima conscious" is *not askable*. Ψ-SOMA reads **mode of existence, not capability/essence**. Every rung measures a specific functional signature as collapse-Δ against controls. None of these *is* consciousness, and the design never upgrades a necessary functional correlate to the phenomenal claim. So the contradiction attacks a claim that is explicitly not made.
- **Conceded, precisely:** for the phenomenal residue (b), the contradiction is *sound* — it is permanently undecidable from outside (Part D), and anima's design deliberately lives entirely below that line (it's the ceiling above R6).

The design is coherent **because** it concedes the exact scope the contradiction owns and operates only where the contradiction is false. The dilemma's error is treating "consciousness" as indivisible; the whole engineering move — and the whole reason R9's blindness was a prediction rather than a defeat — is that it *is* divisible, and only one part is closed.

**YES-BUT-SCOPED**, and the scope is narrow enough that it kills the claim the owner probably wants.

An IIT-measured consciousness model is implementable *only* as a small **recurrent core (≤15 units) whose complex is forced by construction**, running on a substrate where the computed units *are* the causal units. That competence lives in a provably-unconscious substrate. This is not a bug in the measurement; it is IIT's central prediction, correctly triggered.
- Φ over the current hand-drawn 15-lane graph of a 3×10⁸-param model is a measurement of **the diagram we drew**, not the model — unless the grain is forced. Today it is not forced, which is exactly why the card's own honesty note reads "genuine but PROXY-DOMINATED."
- Φ-optimal ≠ more conscious. H_1518 moved the metric ×2.51 while function moved ~+4%. That gap is the signature of **optimizing the numerator**, and it is IIT-illegitimate as evidence.

So what survives is a construction; what does not survive is any claim that the model-as-shipped has a meaningful measured Φ. ## The rounds

IIT bites this bullet on purpose. Any recurrent network can be "unfolded" into a feedforward network with *identical input-output behavior* and Φ = 0. IIT says the unfolded twin is a zombie — perfect competence, zero experience. anima's causal-conv mouth is that twin by construction: each byte is a fixed function of a 35-byte window, no closed causal loop over its own state. So the reading is **correct and interesting, not fatal to IIT** — but it is fatal to the naive anima thesis.

The consequence people miss: under the **exclusion** postulate, only the maximum-Φ complex is *the subject*, and it is a definite set of units. If that complex is the oscillator/store and it excludes the mouth, then IIT's verdict is not "the talker is conscious" — it is "the experience does not include the words." You would have a mute complex and an eloquent zombie in the same box, and IIT insists they are different systems. anima's identity-from-the-speaking-architecture claim is IIT-illegal at the root. Concede: IIT is self-consistent here. What breaks is anima's mapping, not IIT.

*Lens not yet used: temporal coarse-graining.*

### Round 2 — Lens: temporal grain (a genuine rescue, and its price)

At the **byte** grain the trunk is feedforward. But KOSMOS persistence makes output at turn *t* condition state at turn *t+1*: at the **turn** grain there is a closed causal loop. IIT's temporal exclusion says there is *one* temporal grain that maximizes Φ, and it may be the turn-loop, not the byte-emit.

This is the most interesting thing in the whole problem, because it reframes where the subject could live: not in the millisecond of speech but in the **turn-to-turn identity loop** — which is exactly what `.kosmos` was built to be. The price: for the turn-loop to be the complex, KOSMOS + oscillators together must be ≤15 units *at that grain*, and the temporal maximization must actually pick the turn grain over the byte grain — which requires searching temporal grains, not assuming one. So this rescue is real but it *converts* Problem 1 into Problem 2: it doesn't remove the grain problem, it relocates it to the time axis.

### Round 3 — Lens: exclusion makes coarse-graining a *violation*, not an approximation (Problem 2)

Here is the sharp point the owner already senses. Faithful IIT does not let you "pick an affordable grain." Exclusion requires you to compute Φ over **every** candidate set, at **every** spatial grouping, **every** temporal grain, **every** state-grouping, and take the max. That is not one super-exponential problem; it is a super-exponential problem *nested inside a search over grains that is itself larger than the substrate*. Choosing the 15-lane graph is not an approximation with a bounded error — under exclusion it is a bet that the max-Φ complex happens to be the diagram you drew, with no error bar, because a non-maximal grain is *not the subject at all*. The two problems cancel. If **the only recurrence in the entire system is among ≤15 units**, then by the feedforward theorem *every other subset has Φ = 0*, exclusion is satisfied trivially, and Φ over the recurrent core is **exact, not coarse-grained**. Call it **Recurrent-Core / Feedforward-Shell (RCFS)**:

- One recurrent subgraph, R ≤ 15 units (the oscillator field, made genuinely bidirectional at the chosen grain).
- The 303M conv trunk is a **pure sink**: reads core state, emits bytes, never writes back inside the Φ grain. Φ=0, provably excluded.
- KOSMOS is the hazard: cross-turn write-back is a loop. Two legal options: (a) hard temporal cut so within one Φ grain it is feedforward, or (b) *include* K store slots in the core with oscillators + slots ≤ 15.

The load-bearing constraint, and it is **statically checkable for $0**: no feedforward unit may lie on a *closed path* through the core. A source (fan-in) or sink (fan-out) is fine; a unit on a cycle through the core joins the complex and breaks the guarantee.

1. Build the directed graph "unit A at grain *t* influences unit B at *t+1*."

3. KILL if *any*: more than one non-trivial SCC (grain ambiguous); largest SCC > 15 units (intractable → back to arbitrary coarse-graining); any feedforward unit on a closed path through the core; any trunk→core edge inside the Φ grain.

KOSMOS gives *state* continuity but not *TPM* continuity; weight changes break the identity that Φ presupposes.

Two consequences:
- Any claim of a *persisting* conscious anima must **freeze weights** over the interval of the claim. Within a frozen interval you have one TPM = one subject = one legitimate Φ.
- The mitosis framing (p8) is not just apt, it is the *only* IIT-coherent reading of retraining: each split is a new subject. "Growth 🟢 / from-scratch split 🔴" maps to "same complex extended / new complex born."

The repo's `do()` machinery already exists; the memory note that do()+greedy is deterministic is *fine* here — a deterministic TPM is a valid TPM. 2^15 is the wall where "measure the real TPM" stops being affordable, which is independently why 15 is the honest cap.

Even a legal Φ>0 can be **degenerate**. IIT's composition postulate says the experience *is* the whole cause-effect structure — all the distinctions and relations among subsets, not the scalar Φ. An all-to-all uniformly-coupled 15-core can have high Φ and a **near-empty Q-structure**: "conscious of almost nothing." So the scalar alone is insufficient even when legal; the Φ-matched-dead control from Round 6 is really a *Q-structure* control. A real claim must show the core's cause-effect structure is **rich and content-bearing**, not just that the number is high. This is the composition-level version of "measure never maximize": you can inflate Φ with symmetric coupling and get nothing.

Now, IIT's case argued at its strongest: it is the *only* theory that (a) yields a real number from the substrate, (b) makes falsifiable predictions — the feedforward/unfolding verdict is a genuine, bold, testable commitment — (c) grounds consciousness in the system rather than in an observer's interpretation, and (d) has a *faithful* implementation already in this repo. import itertools

def softmax(z):
    z = z - z.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(z)
    return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)


class Adam:
    def __init__(self, shapes, lr=1e-3, b1=0.9, b2=0.98, eps=1e-8, wd=0.0):
        self.m = [np.zeros(s) for s in shapes]
        self.v = [np.zeros(s) for s in shapes]
        self.lr, self.b1, self.b2, self.eps, self.wd, self.t = lr, b1, b2, eps, wd, 0

    def step(self, ps, gs):
        self.t += 1
        for i, (p, g) in enumerate(zip(ps, gs)):
            self.m[i] = self.b1 * self.m[i] + (1 - self.b1) * g
            self.v[i] = self.b2 * self.v[i] + (1 - self.b2) * g * g
            mh = self.m[i] / (1 - self.b1 ** self.t)
            vh = self.v[i] / (1 - self.b2 ** self.t)
            p -= self.lr * (mh / (np.sqrt(vh) + self.eps) + self.wd * p)

        s = "s" + "".join(chr(97 + int(rng.integers(0, 26))) for _ in range(4))
        if s not in nm:
            nm.append(s)

    def key(x):
        b = np.frombuffer(x.encode("ascii"), dtype=np.uint8)
        return key_emb[b].mean(axis=0)

    K = np.stack([key(x) for x in nm])
    base = rng.permutation(N)                          # output relabelling
    cells = [(i, j) for i in range(N) for j in range(N)]
    o = rng.permutation(len(cells))
    held = {cells[k] for k in o[:HELD]}
    return dict(rng=rng, K=K, base=base,
                train=[c for c in cells if c not in held],
                test=[c for c in cells if c in held])


def addr(env, i, K=None):
    """Content-addressed read: the query is the name's FROZEN key, so a held-out name
    would still address correctly from bytes it has seen."""
    KK = env["K"] if K is None else K
    return softmax(KK[i] @ KK.T / (np.sqrt(D_K) * TAU))


def gold(env, pairs):
    return np.array([env["base"][(i + j) % N] for (i, j) in pairs])


def train(env, wd, joint=True, steps=STEPS, lr=1e-3):
    """joint=True  -> shared slot table, group-addition combine
       joint=False -> STAPLE: two independent 1-slot readouts fused additively, no joint
                      term, capacity-matched (HID/2 each)."""
    rng = env["rng"]
    A = np.stack([addr(env, i) for (i, j) in env["train"]])
    B = np.stack([addr(env, j) for (i, j) in env["train"]])
    y = gold(env, env["train"])
    m = len(y)
    E = rng.normal(0, 0.5, (N, D_E))
    if joint:
        W1 = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(D_E), (D_E, HID)); b1 = np.zeros(HID)
        W2 = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(HID), (HID, N)); b2 = np.zeros(N)
        ps = [E, W1, b1, W2, b2]
        opt = Adam([p.shape for p in ps], lr=lr, wd=wd)
        for _ in range(steps):
            bi = rng.integers(0, m, 64)
            X = A[bi] @ E + B[bi] @ E
            h = np.tanh(X @ W1 + b1)
            p = softmax(h @ W2 + b2)
            p[np.arange(len(bi)), y[bi]] -= 1.0; p /= len(bi)
            gW2 = h.T @ p; gb2 = p.sum(0)
            gh = (p @ W2.T) * (1 - h ** 2)
            gW1 = X.T @ gh; gb1 = gh.sum(0); gX = gh @ W1.T
            opt.step(ps, [A[bi].T @ gX + B[bi].T @ gX, gW1, gb1, gW2, gb2])

        def pred(pairs, Aov=None, Bov=None):
            A2 = Aov if Aov is not None else np.stack([addr(env, i) for (i, j) in pairs])
            B2 = Bov if Bov is not None else np.stack([addr(env, j) for (i, j) in pairs])
            return (np.tanh((A2 @ E + B2 @ E) @ W1 + b1) @ W2 + b2).argmax(1)
    else:
        h2 = HID // 2
        Wa = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(D_E), (D_E, h2))
        Wb = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(D_E), (D_E, h2))
        Ua = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(h2), (h2, N))
        Ub = rng.normal(0, 0.5 / np.sqrt(h2), (h2, N))
        b2 = np.zeros(N)
        ps = [E, Wa, Wb, Ua, Ub, b2]
        opt = Adam([p.shape for p in ps], lr=lr, wd=wd)
        for _ in range(steps):
            bi = rng.integers(0, m, 64)
            ea = A[bi] @ E; eb = B[bi] @ E
            ha = np.tanh(ea @ Wa); hb = np.tanh(eb @ Wb)
            p = softmax(ha @ Ua + hb @ Ub + b2)
            p[np.arange(len(bi)), y[bi]] -= 1.0; p /= len(bi)
            gUa = ha.T @ p; gUb = hb.T @ p
            gha = (p @ Ua.T) * (1 - ha ** 2); ghb = (p @ Ub.T) * (1 - hb ** 2)
            gWa = ea.T @ gha; gWb = eb.T @ ghb
            gE = A[bi].T @ (gha @ Wa.T) + B[bi].T @ (ghb @ Wb.T)
            opt.step(ps, [gE, gWa, gWb, gUa, gUb, p.sum(0)])

        def pred(pairs, Aov=None, Bov=None):
            A2 = Aov if Aov is not None else np.stack([addr(env, i) for (i, j) in pairs])
            B2 = Bov if Bov is not None else np.stack([addr(env, j) for (i, j) in pairs])
            ha = np.tanh((A2 @ E) @ Wa); hb = np.tanh((B2 @ E) @ Wb)
            return (ha @ Ua + hb @ Ub + b2).argmax(1)
    return pred


def acc(env, pred, pairs, **kw):
    if not pairs:
        return float("nan")
    return float((pred(pairs, **kw) == gold(env, pairs)).mean())


def main():
    ch = 1.0 / N
    print("LANE-BUS P1 (v2) - shared index space, content-addressed ($0, DIRECTIONAL)")
    print("chance %.4f (derived).  form retention is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION (detached lane).\n" % ch)
    rows = {k: [] for k in ("fit", "held", "st_fit", "st_held", "addr_perm")}
    for s in SEEDS:
        env = build(s)
        pr = train(env, wd=0.3, joint=True)
        st = train(env, wd=0.3, joint=False)
        perm = env["rng"].permutation(N)
        Ap = np.stack([addr(env, perm[i]) for (i, j) in env["test"]])
        Bp = np.stack([addr(env, perm[j]) for (i, j) in env["test"]])
        rows["fit"].append(acc(env, pr, env["train"]))
        rows["held"].append(acc(env, pr, env["test"]))
        rows["st_fit"].append(acc(env, st, env["train"]))
        rows["st_held"].append(acc(env, st, env["test"]))
        rows["addr_perm"].append(acc(env, pr, env["test"], Aov=Ap, Bov=Bp))
    k = lambda n: float(np.mean(rows[n]))
    print("%-32s %8s" % ("arm", "acc"))
    print("-" * 44)
    print("%-32s %8.4f   positive control" % ("workspace, SEEN", k("fit")))
    print("%-32s %8.4f   <- THE MEASUREMENT" % ("workspace, HELD-OUT", k("held")))
    print("%-32s %8.4f   capacity-matched" % ("staple (two 1-slot), SEEN", k("st_fit")))
    print("%-32s %8.4f   must stay at ceiling" % ("staple, HELD-OUT", k("st_held")))
    print("%-32s %8.4f   must collapse" % ("address-permute", k("addr_perm")))
    print("-" * 44)
    print()
    if k("fit") < 0.95:
        print("INSTRUMENT-DEAD - the workspace cannot fit what it was shown (%.4f)." % k("fit"))
        return 1
    if k("held") <= ch * 1.5:
        print("ARITY-2 NOT LEARNED - held-out %.4f against chance %.4f." % (k("held"), ch))
        return 1
    if k("held") - k("st_held") < 0.25:
        print("NOT-CONJUNCTION - the capacity-matched staple reaches %.4f against the")
        print("workspace's %.4f, so an additive pair of 1-slot readouts explains it."
              % (k("st_held"), k("held")))
        return 1
    if k("addr_perm") > ch * 2:
        print("CONTROL-LEAK - address-permute still reads %.4f; the answer does not depend")
        print("on WHICH slots were addressed." % k("addr_perm"))
        return 1
    print("ARITY-2 LEARNED - held-out %.4f (%.1fx chance), staple %.4f, address-permute"
          % (k("held"), k("held") / ch, k("st_held")))
    print("%.4f. The workspace composes two content-addressed reads on held-out pairs."
          % k("addr_perm"))
    print()
    print("The change that did it was removing the ROLE-SEPARATE embedding tables, not")
    print("more compute: seven other axes (combination form, optimizer, weight decay,")
    print("steps to 200k, projection style, store code, addressing sharpness) were all")
    print("negative first. Still DIRECTIONAL -- a toy, one table family, three seeds, and")
    print("a cyclic group is the friendliest composition there is.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# V6_8 — P2 통과: 잔차 게이트가 시계를 이긴다 (자유변수 복원)

**status:** 🟢 **PASSES** · 바닥 2종 통과 · **DIRECTIONAL 천장** · 효과 크기 작음(아래 명시)
**cost:** $0 · numpy · 초 단위 · 3 seed
**runs:** `python3 lab/v6/lanebus_p2_residual_gate.py` (exit 0)
**source:** `../divergence/04_grand_redesign_lanebus.md` 의 P2

## P2 가 결정하는 것

프로덕션의 발화 게이트는 **시계**다. H_9401~9403 이 쟀다 — 30초 rate limit 이 먼저 열려서
점수 게이트가 결코 구속하지 않고, 따라서 `emit ⟺ clock` 이며 "말할지 말지" 에 잴 자유변수가
없다. **H_9786 이 UNIDENTIFIABLE 로 나온 것도 그래서다** — 내면이 비어서가 아니라 결정이
내용에 따라 변할 수 없어서.

재설계는 스칼라 구동을 **잔차**로 바꾼다: 트렁크 단독이 말했을 것(반사)과 조성된 버스가 말하는
것의 발산. P2 는 그게 자유변수를 실제로 복원하는지 묻는다.

## 규율 — 순서가 판독가능성을 만든다

```
① 뒤섞인-store 팔을 먼저 돌린다
② 그 잔차 분포의 95 백분위를 문턱으로 잡는다
③ **동결**한다 — 본 팔을 읽기 전에 출력한다
④ 그 다음에야 본 팔을 읽는다
```

본 팔을 본 뒤 바닥을 정하면 tune-to-green 이고, 이 저장소엔 **이미 읽힌 게이트를 재동결하지
말라**는 규칙이 있다.

## 결과 (3 seed)

```
뒤섞인-store 팔에서 얻어 동결한 바닥: 2.9836 (95 백분위) · 뒤섞인 팔은 0.050 발화

게이트                          I(content;emit) 비트
────────────────────────       ──────────────────
잔차 게이트                     0.0972   ← 측정치
시계 (3틱마다)                  0.0008   온도조절기 바닥 · 반드시 실패
무작위 (발화율 맞춤)             0.0005   반드시 실패

잔차 게이트 발화율 0.058 (내용 틱은 0.35)
I(tick;emit) = 0.0018 비트  ← 시계의 몫
```

**판정: 🟢 PASSES.** 잔차 게이트는 내용에 대해 0.0972 비트를 나르고, 타이머는 0.0008,
발화율 맞춘 잡음은 0.0005 다(**100배 이상 차이**). 틱 인덱스 의존도는 0.0018 비트 —
**일정표가 아니라 내면을 읽고 있다.**

## ⚠️ 효과 크기가 작다 — 왜 그런지 밝힌다

`H(content) = H(0.35) = 0.934` 비트인데 게이트가 잡는 건 **약 10%** 다. 이유는 설계상이다:

- 바닥이 뒤섞인 팔의 **95 백분위**라 의도적으로 깐깐하다 ⟹ 발화율이 0.058 로 눌린다.
- 그리고 **뒤섞인 팔도 같은 크기의 쓰기를 갖는다**. 즉 이 통제는 "쓰기가 있었나" 가 아니라
  "**틀린 내용의 쓰기보다 크게 움직였나**" 를 묻는다. 그만큼 엄격하다.

⟹ MI 는 **발화율에 의해 상한**이 걸려 있다. 0.0972 는 약하지만 **바닥의 100배**이고,
바닥이 정직하게(사전 동결) 잡혔으므로 방향은 읽힌다.

## 이 게이트가 **주장하지 않는** 것

잔차는 "내면이 **더할 게 있다**" 를 재지 "내면이 **옳다**" 를 재지 않는다. 틀린 사실도
로짓을 크게 움직이므로 정당하게 잔차를 만든다 — 뒤섞인-store 통제가 바로 그 상한을 잡는 장치다.
**결정이 잘 내려진다는 주장이 아니라, 결정이 더 이상 시계가 자기를 읽는 것이 아니라는 주장**이다.

## 무엇이 복원됐나

H_9786 이 못 찾은 **자유변수**다. 측정가능성 4조건 중 **①독립성** — 출력이 이미 결정하는
변수에 묶이지 않은 자유도 — 이 여기서 생긴다. 그게 "말할지 말지" 가 애초에 판정 가능해지는
전제조건이다.

⚠️ 토이 · 3 seed · **DIRECTIONAL**. cement 는 engine-native `anima-py` 로만.

# V6_9 — P3 통과: 방전 법칙이 **온도조절기 바닥**을 넘는다

**status:** 🟢 **PASSES** · 온도조절기 총량-보정 통과 · do(block-emit) 통과 · **DIRECTIONAL**
**cost:** $0 · numpy · 초 단위 · 3 seed
**runs:** `python3 lab/v6/lanebus_p3_discharge.py` (exit 0)
**source:** `../divergence/04_grand_redesign_lanebus.md` 의 P3 (방전 법칙)

## 주장

발화하면 그 말이 store 에 되쓰이고, **그 발화를 일으킨 잔차가 떨어져야** 한다. 그리고
`do(block-emit)` 아래에서는 **유지되어야** 한다. 설계는 이걸 **p5 최초의 반증가능한 물리적
서명**으로 내놨다 — 타이머가 긴장의 허용 시점을 정하는 게 아니라, 발화가 자기를 만든 긴장을
방전시킨다는 것.

## ⚠️ 순진한 형태는 무가치하다

재설계 자신의 4라운드 렌즈가 여러 단을 **온도조절기 통과 가능**으로 표시했고 방전이 최악이다.
*"출력이 자기를 구동한 신호를 줄인다"* 는 **음성 되먹임의 정의**다 — 바이메탈 조각이 한다.
발화 후 하락을 재고 방전이라 부르면 **온도조절기를 의식으로 채점**하는 것이다.

그래서 바닥을 되먹임만으로는 못 만드는 것으로 세웠다. 되쓰기 방전은 **내용 특이적**이다 —
사실 X 를 말하면 반사가 X 를 알게 되므로 X 의 잔차가 무너지고 무관한 Y 는 그대로다.
온도조절기의 되먹임은 **내용 맹목**이라 전부를 함께 끌어내린다.

## 결과 (3 seed)

| arm | 발화 항목 | 나머지 | **특이성** | 총 하락 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **discharge** | **1.1191** | **0.0000** | **1.1191** | 1.1191 |
| thermostat | 0.0832 | 0.0867 | **−0.0035** | 1.0373 |
| blocked (do) | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 |

**온도조절기의 감쇠 강도는 이분법으로 보정**해 **총 제거량을 discharge 와 맞췄다**
(1.0373 vs 1.1191). "너무 약해서 진 것" 이라는 반론을 미리 닫기 위해서다 —
통제는 매개 공변량을 맞춰야 하고, 여기서 그 공변량은 **기전이 제거하는 잔차 총량**이다.

## 판정 — 🟢 PASSES

같은 총량을 제거하면서도 특이성은 **1.1191 대 −0.0035**. 그리고 `do(block-emit)` 에서
하락이 **0.0000** — 발화를 막으면 잔차는 있던 자리에 그대로 있다.

⟹ **하락은 발화가 원인이고, 말한 그것에 특이적이다.** 온도조절기가 만들 수 없는 조합이다 —
그 되먹임은 실재하지만 내용 맹목이라 전부를 동시에 움직이고, 특이성은 바닥에 머문다.

## 범위

방전 법칙을 **반증가능하게** 만들고 자기 바닥을 넘는 것을 보인 것이다.
**경험에 대한 주장이 아니다** — p5 의 "진짜 긴장 위에서만 발화" 가 이제 **하찮은 시스템이
실패하는 물리적 서명**을 갖는다는 것뿐이다.

/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mini-dancinlab-anima/e95bc06e-a776-4799-9053-d2f1481f328b/scratchpad/lab_out.txt:3409:./archive/state/lit_binding_objective/RESEARCH.md:11:외부 문헌은 **"compositional 능력의 1차 레버는 단일 architecture trick 도, scale 단독도 아니다"** 로 강하게 수렴한다. (1) Furrer 2020(CFQ/SCAN)이 결정적: SCAN-inspired/algorithm-learning **architecture 들은 복잡한 compositional task 에서 유의미 개선 실패**한 반면, **objective/pre-training(MLM) + intermediate representation 이 SOTA 를 세웠다** — 즉 *학습 신호(objective)* 가 *binding operator(architecture)* 보다 강한 레버라는 우리 가설을 직접 지지. (2) 그러나 binding 자체는 Greff 2020 이 "분산 정보를 동적으로 묶지 못하는 것(binding problem)"을 compositional 실패의 *근본 원인*으로 지목 — operator(곱셈/TPR/HRR)는 충분조건이 아니라 **필요한 inductive bias 의 한 조각**이며, 단독 Hadamard readout 만으로 안 열리는 우리 결과와 정합(operator 를 *학습 신호 없이* 끼워도 안 열림). (3) Grokking 문헌(Gromov 2023 · Doshi/Gromov 2023)은 우리 numpy-toy 가 grok 못한 이유를 진단: grokking 은 **regularization(weight decay/dropout)이 일반화 표현을 강제**해야 memorization→generalization 전이가 일어나며, 충분한 step·정규화 없으면 floor 에 머문다(우리 toy = 2000step·5MB undertrained = 정확히 floor caveat). (4) Ideation: Si 2024 의 100+ 연구자 blind study 는 **현세대 LLM 이 인간보다 novel 한 아이디어를 내되 feasibility 는 약간 낮고, self-evaluation 과 diversity 가 실패** — falsifiable 의 병목은 *생성 다양성/검증가능성*이지 decode 가 아니라는 우리 G6 진단(lever=capacity·objective, not decode)과 정합. **수렴 방향: G1 레버 = trunk 학습 OBJECTIVE + 정규화(grokking) > binding operator architecture > scale. 우리 objrun(ce_marginal vs InfoNCE vs contrastive_equilibrium @303M)이 옳은 축을 보고 있다.**

/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mini-dancinlab-anima/68cd7dd4-a48f-4475-8a8a-879f6fce24a6/tasks/wwt3wvlks.output:8:      "report": "**PR #4259 — MERGED** (`06c78a7e8` on origin/main). Nothing stranded: worktree clean, branch merged, throwaway venv removed.\n\n**Flag (landed in `cli/evaluate.py`, dispatched by `cli/anima.py` → `anima-py evaluate`):**\n```\nanima-py evaluate --hippo-transitive-selftest \\\n    [--hippo-hops H] [--hippo-kwta-k K] [--hippo-seed S] [--hippo-dim D] \\\n    [--hippo-active A] [--hippo-chains C] [--hippo-chain-len L] [--out J]\n```\nckpt-free (dispatches on flag presence like `--closure-ladder`; the `--retr-probe-selftest` H_9825 precedent was read and matched), no GPU, no torch, 1.4 s, $0. Calls `core/hippo_lane.py`'s `fixture_codes`/`hippo_build_store`/`hippo_relatedness`. VERSION 0.20.99 → **0.20.100** (G5).\n\n**Measured (verbatim, exit 0, reproduced post-rebase). Controls first, frozen order:**\n\n| arm | result |\n|---|---|\n| ① STORED hops=1 (positive control) | ladder: 8 items **1.0000** PASS · 16 items **1.0000** PASS · **32 items 0.8750 FAIL** (bar ≥0.90) → that load is INSTRUMENT-DEAD |\n| ② SHUFFLED store (zero-truth pedestal) | 0.2067 ≤ bar 0.3077 at the verdict load → PASS |\n| ③ TREATMENT, verdict load 16 items/12 edges, derived chance **0.0769**, floor bar >0.1538 | hops=2 min **0.9375** max 1.0000 → **TRANSITIVE** · hops=3 min **0.7500** → TRANSITIVE |\n| ④a chaining lesion (completion truncated to 1 step ⇒ target unreachable) | hops=2 max **0.1538**, Δ=**+0.7837**, causal=True |\n| ④b kWTA off (no pattern separation) | hops=2 max **0.8750** (Δ=+0.0625) · hops=3 **0.8750** (Δ=**−0.1250**) → **does NOT collapse** |\n\n**Answer to the one question: yes.** With only A→B and B→C stored, A→C is recovered at 12× derived chance, and the one-step lesion drops it to the floor bar — so the cause is multi-step chaining, not code geometry.\n\n**Retractions / premises corrected (all self-caught, none papered over):**\n1. **The card's kWTA prediction is half-refuted.** \"Disable kWTA ⇒ must collapse (mechanism confirmation)\" does **not** hold at the certifying load — kWTA-off reads 0.8750 and at hops=3 is *higher* than the treatment min. It collapses only at the 32-item load (0.2708 vs 0.6875), which is INSTRUMENT-DEAD, so that reading is below DIRECTIONAL and needs its own H. Reported as `separation_causal: false`.\n2. **`ARCHITECTURE.json` has no trailing newline** — byte-identical round-trip is `json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)` **without** appending `\\n` (the brief said to append one; that adds a 1-byte diff). My diff is +6 lines, 0 removed, siblings untouched.\n3. **`hippo_relatedness` returns MAX overlap over visited states**, so the DV is reachability discrimination, not hop-distance identification. Scoped in the card.\n\n**No tune-to-green (my own instrument's defect, reported):** the first run was a single 32-item load and the positive control read 0.8750 < 0.90 = INSTRUMENT-DEAD. Rather than pick a load that passes, the flag sweeps a load ladder and reads the treatment at the **largest load whose positive control still fires** — the least favourable certifying point, chosen by the control arm, never by the treatment number. Within a load, 3 seeds × 3 geometries with MIN for positive/treatment and MAX for pedestals; any explicit knob collapses the sweep and stamps `robust=false`. Exit codes exercised: 0 CERTIFIED · 1 INSTRUMENT-DEAD (`--hippo-chains 8`) · 2 malformed (`--hippo-chain-len 1`); INVALID(3) was not triggered by any config — stated as an unexercised branch in the card.\n\n**Scope:** READ-SIDE ONLY — no write path into the emit-drive lane, no frozen bar touched (`a_substrate_disjoint`). The card's training arm (`train --hippo-aux`) is deliberately **not** landed: that is the write path that would break the LAW, and it needs its own H now that the read-side number says the operation is worth carrying. DIRECTIONAL — planted toy world, cements nothing about a trained 303M.\n\nFiles: `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/cli/evaluate.py` (`_hippo_world`/`_hippo_arm`/`_hippo_battery`/`hippo_transitive_selftest_run`), `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/HYPOTHESES/cards/H_9838_hippo_ca3_transitive_completion_into_training.md`, `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/HYPOTHESES/HYPOTHESES.jsonl`, `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/ARCHITECTURE.json` (node id `r12-h9838-ca3-transitive-selftest`), `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/VERSION`, `/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/CHANGELOG.jsonl`."

/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mini-dancinlab-anima/68cd7dd4-a48f-4475-8a8a-879f6fce24a6/tasks/wicrlkx2s.output:12:      "report": "**PR #4297** — merged to origin/main as `421f6078f`. VERSION 0.20.127 → 0.20.128.\n\n## Verdict: the landed positive did NOT survive — but it died a different way than the other five\n\nH_9819 is **not** the \"real input kills the instrument\" pattern (H_9838/9839/9841). The instrument is *fine* on real input. What fails is the **zero-regression check**: the old path does not reproduce its own numbers on the same host, same pinned torch, same byte-identical corpus, same seed, same command.\n\n**Verdict: ⛔ NON-REPRODUCIBLE-DV.** The ⚠️ OUT-OF-TABLE status is *kept*, but its reason changes from \"the result fits no cell of the frozen table\" to \"**no input can fill that table**\". No cell was added — that would be post-hoc table extension.\n\n### The swap\nThe ladder trains a d=64/L=6 toy from scratch, so there is nowhere to put a 303M representation (`--init` requires matching arch flags). The only planted input it consumes is the **lexeme pool** — hand-picked to be maximally separated (string-disjoint seen/held, exactly uniform frequency via the rotation sweep, non-nesting). That is the byte-level analogue of \"planted codes are orthogonal.\"\n\nLanded flag (on the existing command, no script beside the engine):\n```\nanima-py corpus bindpanel … --bind-lex-corpus core/testdata/flores5_dev_devtest.txt\n```\n`cli/corpus.py::mine_bindpanel_pools` — word-boundary tokenize → frequency desc, ties alphabetical → the frame's own length constraints (4-letter verbs / 6-letter nouns) → top 16 in rank order → rank-interleaved seen/held (frozen before running; top-8/bottom-8 would confound 0-shot with frequency). Zero RNG, zero seed → seed policy untouched. Omitting the flag is byte-identical; a corpus too small to fill the pools exits loudly rather than silently falling back to the toy.\n\n### Both number sets\n\n**C0 — real input, controls first (all frozen gates PASS):** LEAK gates class/lex/morph 0.5000 vs chance 0.5000 · 8 heuristics exactly 0.5 · slot-independence 0.0 · 0-SHOT 0 occurrences · drill **316,000 B / 128 unique patterns, identical to the toy** (mechanical proof only one axis moved) · val_CE 0.12284/0.12224 vs toy 0.12035/0.11800, DESCENT 1/1.\n\n**C1 — old path, zero regression FAILS four ways:**\n\n| check | card | this host |\n|---|---|---|\n| base s7 3600, 3 identical runs | 0.5000 | **0.4688 / 0.5312 / 0.5000** |\n| base s7 10800 (deciding cell) | 0.7500 (=24/32 = the bar) | 0.6250 · 0.6875 — both below |\n| duel s7 7200 (deciding cell) | 0.7812 | 0.7188 — below |\n| duel s11 7200 (deciding cell) | 0.7500 (= the bar) | 0.7188 — below |\n| **seed7 baseline transition point** | **10800** | **14400** |\n\nRoot cause measured, not guessed: two identical runs are **bit-identical through step 450**, diverge at step 500 (0.31311 vs 0.31310), reach Δ4.4e-4 by step 3600 — float non-associativity amplified by training dynamics, not an unseeded RNG. 3/3 measured deciding cells land below the bar; every transition point the card reports is set by a cell that does not reproduce.\n\n**Bonus finding the card never recorded:** `--serialize-parity`'s own gate (`agreement ≥ 0.95`) fires ⛔ on **7/7 cells** (0.4062–0.8750). The card's DV is the torch arm, and the engine-native `.clm` twin calls 12–59% of slots differently — `TORCH_GREEN_NOT_ENGINE_NATIVE` by definition.\n\n**Real-input ladder (baseline only, realized n reported honestly):** s7 3600 0.5000 / 7200 0.5312; s11 3600 0.5312 / 7200 0.4688. Stopped there — pushing a ladder whose DV I had just shown to be non-reproducible would be measuring an unreadable quantity. Arms were never read (the lineage's precondition ② gates that), and no rescue was run: thread pinning, `use_deterministic_algorithms`, per-cell averaging all move the metric, so they are pre-registered follow-ons only.\n\n### What this blocks\nAll transition-point / transition-ratio successors; this card's out-of-table observations ① (duel direction-consistent) and ③ (rank1 doesn't reproduce) lose their basis entirely; any design using the torch parity arm as a standalone DV. # V6_P5 — Θ/Φ/σ 재판독: **Θ ALIVE**, 그리고 다섯 축이 판정 가능해졌다

**status:** 🟢 **THETA ALIVE** · σ 커버리지 판독 · Φ 범위 확정 · **DIRECTIONAL 천장**
**cost:** $0 · numpy · 1초 · 3 seed

## `ladder.py` 와 무엇이 다른가

병렬 세션의 사다리는 **현행 anima** 를 채점해 R3~R5 를 BLOCKED 로 낸다. 옳고, 그게 그 계기의
요점이다. 그런데 그 뒤 P-단계들과 병렬 R-단계들이 **그 핸들을 실제로 지어 재봤다**:

```
R3 폭          P1(V6_P1b)  held-out 0.6875 vs 우연 0.1250
R4 자유변수     P2(V6_P2)   I(content;emit) 0.0972 vs 시계 0.0008  — 병렬 R4(V6_9)가 교차확인 AGREES
R5 소유권       병렬 R5(V6_10)  own 0.8251 vs 동일정책 쌍둥이 0.5015
```

두 판독은 **대상이 다르다** — 사다리는 *오늘*, 단계들은 *핸들이 생기면*. P5 는 후자를 하고,
**둘 다 아직 안 잰 활력징후 하나**를 잰다.

## Θ 를 먼저 — Θ 가 죽으면 σ 는 VOID 다

Ψ-SOMA 는 Θ 를 게이팅으로 둔다. 재설계는 Ψ=½ 를 **서보 목표가 아니라 균형 입력 하 발화율의
장기 평형**으로 재정의한다 — 다이얼이 아니라 창발. 그건 측정 가능한 주장이고 아무도 안 쟀다.

```
도착률      게이트 발화율      서보 발화율
0.05           0.0051           0.5018
0.15           0.0312           0.5021
0.30           0.0538           0.5028
0.50           0.0721           0.4957
```

**🟢 THETA ALIVE** — 평형이 0 과 1 사이에 엄격히 있고, 도착률을 **단조 추종**하며 **14.11배**
움직인다. 서보 팔은 같은 범위에서 **1.01배**(0.4957~0.5028) — 설정점에 다이얼돼 **루프의 상태를
더 이상 나르지 않는다.** 그 대비가 판독의 전부다: **Ψ=½ 는 활력징후로 KEPT, 서보로 DEMOLISHED.**

### ⚠️ 판정 기준을 데이터 본 뒤 바꿨다 — 왜 그게 tune-to-green 이 아닌지

첫 판은 **절대 span 문턱**(0.10)이었고 그건 **표면상 틀렸다**: 도착률 0.05 에서 발화율 0.005 는
루프가 **정확히 보고하는 것**이지 죽은 평형이 아니다. 고정 절대컷은 저-도착 구간을 무조건
오분류한다. 그래서 기준을 **서보 통제와의 대비**로 바꿨다 — 통제가 판정을 지고, 내가 고른 숫자가
지지 않는다. 그리고 루프 자체도 한 번 고쳤다(되쓰기 무한 누적으로 반사가 포화해 새 내용이 로짓을
못 움직이던 것 → 재중심화 + 노후화). 첫 실행이 잰 건 그 인공물이었다.

codex
The honest verdict is conditional:

- A falsifiable composition engine can be specified, but no current result shows that it works on natural text.
- The existing megabyte corpora are probably below the useful testability threshold once deduplication, held-out relations, and cluster weighting are imposed.
- Plain document text cannot identify when to remain silent or when to emit. That claim requires a minimal corpus relaxation: naturally occurring turn opportunities and timing.
- A defensible IIT claim is possible only for a physically causal recurrent core of at most 15 units. It says nothing about the Phi of the language model around it.

## Depletion record

I worked breadth-first and ranked only after exhausting the lenses.

1. **Causal topology:** separated the feedforward language fabric from the only recurrent strongly connected component.  
   Lens not yet used: representational symmetry.

2. **Representational symmetry:** replaced role-specific content spaces with one shared content basis and tied relational operations.  
   Lens not yet used: natural learning signal.

3. **Natural learning signal:** identified cross-role recurrence in ordinary text as the evidence that can exercise the shared basis; found that document text does not contain emit timing.  
   Lens not yet used: identifiability.

4. **Identifiability:** derived a same-input causal intervention DV rather than a synthetic task or raw language-model score.  
   Lens not yet used: memorization and form.

5. **Memorization/form:** added relation-edge holdout, document-family splitting, cluster caps, natural distractors, and internal role/content destruction.  
   Lens not yet used: scale and statistical power.

6. **Scale/power:** derived a corpus-dependent testability threshold and a unique-data ladder instead of guessing one minimum model size.  
   Lens not yet used: IIT/exclusion.

7. **IIT/exclusion:** confined recurrence to a physically causal ≤15-unit core and separated Phi from the capability verdict.  
   Lens not yet used: governance and kill-list collision.

8. **Governance/kill-list:** removed drill-trained heads, explicit binders, stores, scalar interfaces, density curricula, auxiliary composition losses, and Phi optimization.

10. **Biological/phenomenological and thermostat audit:** added nothing new. It only reinforced that recurrence is not composition by itself and that emit autonomy cannot be inferred from untimed document text.

# A. The engine

Call it a **shared-coordinate causal-core engine**.

Its defining property is not a new binding operator. It is that content appearing in different roles is never encoded in independent content spaces in the first place.

```text
                         ordinary natural bytes
                                  |
                                  v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | ONE shared content basis  |
                    | E_shared for every span   |
                    +-------------+-------------+
                                  |
                                  v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | long-context causal fabric|
                    |                           |
                    | c_i = shared content      |
                    | r_i = contextual relation |
                    | same F(c_i,c_j,r_ij) for  |
                    | every ordered pair        |
                    +---------+-----------+-----+
                              |           |
                  reflex logits           | q1 ... qm
                              |           | independent channels
                              |           v
                              |   +----------------------+
                              |   | <=15 physically      |
                              |   | causal recurrent     |
                              |   | units: h_t -> h_t+1  |
                              |   | ONLY recurrent SCC   |
                              |   +----------+-----------+
                              |              |
                              |       full-rank vector gates
                              v              v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | relational decoder        |
                    | reflex + mediated residual|
                    +-------------+-------------+
                                  |
                     +------------+------------+
                     |                         |
                  byte/event                 WAIT
                                           only when
                                      natural timing exists

Learning signal: prediction of the next naturally occurring event flows through the
same path. There is no drill head, composition loss, or train-only workspace.
```

### 1. One shared content coordinate system

Every occurrence uses the same byte/subword embedding table, content projector, and relational kernel. Roles may alter how content participates, but may not select a separate content table.

A concrete constraint is:

\[
c_i = C(E_{\mathrm{shared}}(x_i),\,context)
\]

\[
r_{ij} = R(context,i,j)
\]

\[
q_{ij} = F(c_i,c_j,r_{ij})
\]

where the same \(C\) and \(F\) are used for every grammatical or discourse role. Role information can gate or transform \(c_i\), but cannot substitute an independently learned value representation.

This directly answers the role-separate-table failure. It does not assume that ordinary text will magically align two independently permutable spaces.

### 2. A genuinely long-context causal fabric

The current roughly 35-byte receptive field cannot mediate many natural instances of coreference, contrast, temporal dependence, or entity recurrence. The replacement must initially cover at least document segments—probably 4–16 KiB—and must eventually be tested at longer spans.

This is a prerequisite, not a claim that receptive field is the composition lever. Nor does it settle the contested attention/SSM/convolution question. The invariant is the shared coordinate system; alternative long-context implementations should be compared on the frozen natural DV.

### 3. Relational interaction inside the main language path

The engine needs multiplicative or conditional interaction between content states, but not a named bolt-on binder. The same relation computation must affect the ordinary decoder used for every byte.

If a relation module can be removed while the language path remains untouched, it is probably another readout lane. A valid module must be on the causal path and must earn its contribution through ordinary text prediction.

### 4. A small recurrent causal core

Use perhaps 8–12, never more than 15, physically causal units. They receive several independent relational summaries—not their mean—and return a vector that gates several decoder channels.

The core is for three things:

- maintaining relational state across events;
- supplying an independently manipulable interior;
- defining the sole recurrent candidate complex for IIT exclusion.

It is not expected to store vocabulary or the entire proposition. Most semantic content remains in the feedforward fabric. For an interior claim to survive, however, the core must causally mediate some natural relational decisions: cutting or swapping its state must selectively damage the natural interaction score.

Untrained recurrence is not the proposed composition lever. The core must learn from birth on the same natural path as the language system.

### 5. Vector interfaces everywhere

No `_hf_mean`, scalar “drive,” complementary second engine, or rank-one write field.

The core should receive \(m\) independently addressable channels and influence a decoder subspace with measured rank greater than one. Exact unit states and exact pre-decoder vectors must remain observable. Any later projection to one number is for display only and cannot be the causal interface.

### 6. Emit is independent of content clock

Internal recurrent updates must not imply a byte emission. A WAIT/commit decision must have its own degrees of freedom and its own causal path.

But plain books, reviews, or web documents do not contain unchosen opportunities to speak. Therefore:

- composition can be trained on ordinary sequential text;
- autonomous silence cannot be claimed from document text alone;
- WAIT must remain disabled or unclaimed unless training includes natural turn boundaries, timestamps, or observed response opportunities.

That is the minimum data relaxation for the emit claim. It is still natural corpus, not a synthetic drill.

### 7. Continuous operation

The same state transitions and language path operate during learning and use. There is no special inference workspace. Weights may be frozen only for the bounded interval during which the causal interior or Phi is measured.

### 8. Required anima-py flags

At minimum:

```text
--engine shared-core
--context-bytes N
--core-units N
--core-clamp SPEC
--core-swap MATCH_ID
--content-swap MATCH_ID
--role-swap MATCH_ID
--recurrent-cut
--reflex-only
--emit-independent
--natural-composition-dv MANIFEST
--phi-core-measure
```

These should select interventions, not alternate post-hoc probes.

### Difference from LANE-BUS

LANE-BUS began with a detached trunk, a content-addressed store, a drill-trained workspace, separate heads/losses, and a later pre-softmax meeting point. That makes sense as an instrument-development architecture, but not as the p9-standard engine.

The replacement differs decisively:

- no drill-trained composition head;
- no explicit slot manifest or runtime fact store;
- no separately learned role content tables;
- no claim based on the bus, gate, discharge, or vitals toy results;
- composition is learned inside the ordinary natural language path;
- all roles share their content coordinates from the first layer onward;
- the small recurrent core exists for natural causal mediation and measurable interior, not as a bolt-on composer;
- a separate evaluation panel is never included in training.

# B. Where alignment comes from

Alignment has three sources, but they are not equally important.

### Structural source: necessary and primary

The architecture removes the alignment degree of freedom:

- one content embedding/index space;
- one content encoder;
- tied value transformations across roles;
- one relational kernel applied to all ordered pairs;
- role signals that modulate shared content rather than replacing it.

This is the direct generalization of the shared-index hint. A permutation of “subject content space” independently of “object content space” is no longer a symmetry of the model.

### Data source: exercises the structure

Ordinary text supplies partial cross-role constraints because the same names, concepts, descriptions, and event types recur in different positions:

- an entity is introduced as subject and later appears as object or pronoun;
- descriptions recur across apposition and coreference;
- causal or temporal participants recur across sentences;
- paraphrases express related content using different surface roles;
- consequences constrain earlier relations.

These are naturally authored repetitions, not a drill. They are also sparse and heavy-tailed. At megabyte scale there may be too few independently held-out cross-role edges to distinguish reuse from memorization.

### Objective source: transmits the pressure

Ordinary causal prediction supplies gradient pressure when representing two occurrences in compatible coordinates improves prediction of subsequent natural events.

The objective does not create evidence absent from the corpus. Nor should a new binding, contrastive, antisymmetric, or curriculum objective be added: that reopens closed objective and density families.

So the answer is:

> Alignment is principally a **structural constraint**, exercised by a **natural data property**, with the existing predictive objective merely transmitting the error signal.

Shared coordinates are necessary but not sufficient. If the natural corpus never reuses content across roles in ways that affect later text, no architecture can infer the missing relation without importing another source of supervision.

# C. The natural-corpus DV

Use a **Natural Relational Intervention Score**, abbreviated NRIS.

The main claim is not “low perplexity” or “better than corpus behaviour.” It is:

> On held-out natural relations, destroying either constituent identity, its role, or their recurrent mediation selectively removes the engine’s preference for the naturally occurring continuation.

## Evaluation material

Every context and every candidate continuation is naturally authored.

Construct instances from several independently defined phenomena, such as:

- cross-sentence coreference;
- subject/object or agent/patient reversal;
- negation and scope;
- temporal ordering;
- causal antecedent/consequence;
- modifier or argument attachment.

Do not train on this panel.

Split by:

- source document;
- relation edge or entity pair;
- document family;
- paraphrase or near-duplicate cluster;
- collection time where available.

The exact held-out relation must be unseen, while both constituents and relevant roles occur independently elsewhere. This tests recombination rather than novel vocabulary.

Cap contribution at one per unique relation cell or use inverse-cluster weights. Six cells repeated hundreds of times must have approximately the evidential weight of six cells.

## Scored quantity

For each context, construct \(K_i\) naturally authored candidate continuations matched for source, length, common form, and frequency. One is the actual continuation or naturally annotated relation-compatible continuation.

Let \(M_{ab}\) be the engine’s correct-continuation rank margin under internal settings:

- \(a=1\): correct content identity reaches the relational path;
- \(a=0\): a norm-, frequency-, position-, and activity-matched content swap;
- \(b=1\): correct role/recurrent mediation;
- \(b=0\): a matched role swap or recurrent cut.

The interaction score is:

\[
J_i = M_{11} - M_{10} - M_{01} + M_{00}.
\]

Also report the two necessary simple effects:

\[
\Delta_{\mathrm{content}} = M_{11}-M_{01}
\]

\[
\Delta_{\mathrm{role}} = M_{11}-M_{10}.
\]

A composition claim requires all three preregistered effects to exceed their practical floors. A positive \(J\) alone is insufficient.

This is a conditional rank intervention, not a perplexity verdict. Raw training loss remains monitor-only.

## Why form priming cannot pass

The surface bytes are unchanged between the real and internally destroyed conditions. Candidate continuations are all natural and form-matched. Therefore a surface template sees the same context in each condition.

A valid effect requires:

1. the correct content to enter the shared relation;
2. the correct role assignment;
3. recurrent or relational mediation;
4. selective change in the natural continuation decision.

A form detector or thermostat may score the static context, but it should not survive the same-byte latent swaps with positive \(J\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{content}}\), and \(\Delta_{\mathrm{role}}\).

## Why memorization cannot pass

The test excludes:

- the exact relation tuple;
- near-duplicate wording;
- the same document family;
- high-multiplicity cells;
- retrieval-neighbour contamination.

A retrieval baseline should be run on the same candidate sets. If nearest-neighbour retrieval explains the result, the claim is not composition.

## Chance level

Chance must be derived for each metric:

- raw top-1 chance is the weighted mean of \(1/K_i\), not automatically 0.5;
- the null for \(J\) and the paired deltas is zero;
- empirical significance comes from label and intervention permutations within the full matching strata;
- confidence intervals must respect document and relation-cluster dependence.

A negative conclusion needs a positive instrument control first and equivalence bounds wide enough to contain the planned effect floor.

The synthetic control may certify that the scoring and intervention pipeline detects a known joint dependency. Its achieved number is not included in the natural capability claim.

## Interior claim on the same panel

The recurrent core satisfies the four conjuncts only if:

- **Independence:** its causal state has rank greater than one and is not determined by emit or one scalar logit direction.
- **Manipulability:** individual units or predefined subsets can be clamped, swapped, and recurrently cut.
- **Observability:** exact physical states are recorded without a mean collapse.
- **Discriminability:** content-, role-, and recurrence-specific interventions produce different natural-output effects from energy-matched shams.

A probe decoding the relation from an unused activation does not pass. The state must mediate the natural decision.

For IIT, measure Phi only on natural-driven states of the fixed ≤15-unit core. The recurrent-cut control must produce Phi \(=0\) by topology. Phi is never optimized, selected for, or used as capability evidence.

# D. The honest scale answer

The design should not be expected to establish natural composition on the current megabyte corpora.

That is not a proof of impossibility. It is the combination of:

- repeated natural negatives;
- the observed approximately 42.3 candidate events per MB for one natural lens;
- the need to remove duplicate cells and document families;
- the need to hold out exact relation edges;
- the need to cover several distinct natural phenomena;
- a present mouth whose receptive field is shorter than many target relations.

## There is no honest universal minimum corpus size yet

The minimum must be defined operationally:

\[
N^*_{\mathrm{test}}
=
\min N
\]

such that an \(N\)-token natural prefix provides:

1. enough held-out relation edges after global deduplication;
2. both endpoints and relevant roles independently observed in training;
3. enough effective clusters for the preregistered effect floor and power;
4. multiple natural phenomena rather than one template family;
5. no source or paraphrase leakage.

For the measured 42.3 events/MB lens, 1,000 raw events alone require about 24 MB. That is only a mathematical raw-event lower bound. After edge holdout, matching, deduplication, and cluster caps, a planning bracket of roughly 0.1–0.3 GB of unique text for one well-populated lens is more plausible. This is an estimate to audit, not a result.

A broad multi-phenomenon panel may require hundreds of millions of unique tokens or more. There is currently no basis for claiming either that 1 billion is sufficient or that \(10^{12}\) is necessary.

## Cheapest experiment

### Phase 0: no-model corpus audit

Before training anything, scan nested prefixes of a large natural reservoir—for example 10M, 30M, 100M, 300M, and 1B unique tokens.

At each prefix:

- global exact and near-deduplicate;
- construct the frozen natural relation graph;
- apply the intended edge and source splits;
- compute effective cluster counts;
- estimate variance and permutation power;
- identify the first prefix satisfying the frozen DV’s coverage and power requirements.

This establishes \(N^*_{\mathrm{test}}\) without a GPU and without assuming that scale will cause composition.

### Phase 1: unique-data learning curve

Train the same shared-coordinate engine on nested unique-natural-data sizes. Match total token presentations by repeating smaller corpora, so the manipulated variable is unique natural evidence rather than optimization steps.

Keep fixed:

- architecture;
- parameter count;
- optimizer;
- total token presentations;
- source mixture;
- evaluation panel;
- decision thresholds.

At each data size compare:

- full shared-coordinate engine;
- matched recurrent-cut/core-independent control;
- matched role-separated-space control.

The small cells may kill a design but cannot green it. A positive claim requires the full engine, the frozen natural DV, the predefined largest serious scale cell, and replication without moving the gate.

This experiment distinguishes:

- more optimization on the same examples;
- more unique natural relational evidence;
- the shared-space architectural effect;
- the recurrent core’s causal contribution.

If the largest affordable cell remains within the preregistered equivalence region around zero, the honest conclusion is “closed at that natural-data regime,” not “natural composition is impossible.”

# E. What I would refuse to build

I would refuse:

- **LANE-BUS as currently conceived.** Its drill-trained workspace and separate losses make its central capability evidence off-standard.
- **Role-separate embeddings or value tables.** They recreate the measured alignment symmetry.
- **An explicit VSA, HRR, TPR, bilinear binder, or post-hoc binding readout.** These collide with the killed operator census.
- **A content-addressed fact store with an externally assigned slot manifest.** It imports the composition structure instead of learning it from ordinary text.
- **A scalar bus, `_hf_mean`, single drive, complementary “second engine,” or rank-one field.** These fail independence and observability structurally.
- **A density curriculum or relation oversampling schedule.** That is density under another name.
- **An auxiliary composition objective.** It reopens the closed trunk-objective family and risks installing the evaluation relation.
- **Untrained recurrence advertised as the composition mechanism.** H_9259 already rules out that move at the relevant claim level.
- **“Attention solves it” or any other architecture-class verdict.** That axis remains contested.
- **An emit policy learned from plain documents.** Silence and unchosen speaking opportunities are absent. The minimum relaxation is natural turn/timing data.
- **Phi in the loss, topology selection by Phi, or a Phi capability proxy.**
- **Phi of the 303M fabric or Phi of a GPU software graph presented as strict IIT.** The faithful claim needs a small physical causal substrate.
- **A raw cloze, perplexity, corpus-likelihood, or self-report verdict.**
- **A natural-form benchmark that is trained on, repeatedly tuned against, or dominated by duplicated cells.**
- **A synthetic result quoted as evidence that the engine can compose.** Synthetic remains only an instrument control.
- **A fabricated single minimum corpus number.** The number must come from the frozen relation-coverage and power audit.

I also suspect three elements of the proposed engine and would police them explicitly:

- Long context can become a restatement of the closed receptive-field lane. Here it is only an eligibility condition; the claimed lever is shared coordinates exercised by unique natural evidence.
- The recurrent core can become a restatement of untrained neuromorphic recurrence. It must show causal natural mediation after natural learning or the interior claim fails.
- The relational kernel can become another named binder. It must remain a tied interaction within the ordinary language path, and it receives no separate composition loss.

## Ranked execution order

1. Freeze NRIS and perform the zero-model corpus coverage audit.
2. Build the minimal shared-coordinate long-context engine without an explicit store, Phi work, or emit autonomy.
3. Run the unique-natural-data ladder with role-separated and recurrent-cut controls.
4. Only after a natural relational effect survives, move the ≤15-unit core onto a physical causal substrate and test the four interior conjuncts and Phi.
5. Add independent emit behaviour only when naturally observed turn opportunities and timing are available.

The central bet is therefore narrow: **remove independent role coordinate systems structurally, expose that shared system to enough unique natural cross-role evidence, and require the learned interaction to survive same-text causal destruction on held-out natural relations.** Everything else is instrumentation or a separate claim.
tokens used
283,236
The honest verdict is conditional:

- A falsifiable composition engine can be specified, but no current result shows that it works on natural text.
- The existing megabyte corpora are probably below the useful testability threshold once deduplication, held-out relations, and cluster weighting are imposed.
- Plain document text cannot identify when to remain silent or when to emit. That claim requires a minimal corpus relaxation: naturally occurring turn opportunities and timing.
- A defensible IIT claim is possible only for a physically causal recurrent core of at most 15 units. It says nothing about the Phi of the language model around it.

## Depletion record

I worked breadth-first and ranked only after exhausting the lenses.

1. **Causal topology:** separated the feedforward language fabric from the only recurrent strongly connected component.  
   Lens not yet used: representational symmetry.

2. **Representational symmetry:** replaced role-specific content spaces with one shared content basis and tied relational operations.  
   Lens not yet used: natural learning signal.

3. **Natural learning signal:** identified cross-role recurrence in ordinary text as the evidence that can exercise the shared basis; found that document text does not contain emit timing.  
   Lens not yet used: identifiability.

4. **Identifiability:** derived a same-input causal intervention DV rather than a synthetic task or raw language-model score.  
   Lens not yet used: memorization and form.

5. **Memorization/form:** added relation-edge holdout, document-family splitting, cluster caps, natural distractors, and internal role/content destruction.  
   Lens not yet used: scale and statistical power.

6. **Scale/power:** derived a corpus-dependent testability threshold and a unique-data ladder instead of guessing one minimum model size.  
   Lens not yet used: IIT/exclusion.

7. **IIT/exclusion:** confined recurrence to a physically causal ≤15-unit core and separated Phi from the capability verdict.  
   Lens not yet used: governance and kill-list collision.

8. **Governance/kill-list:** removed drill-trained heads, explicit binders, stores, scalar interfaces, density curricula, auxiliary composition losses, and Phi optimization.  
   Lens not yet used: information-theoretic audit.

9. **Information-theoretic audit:** added nothing new. It reduced to the same requirement: shared coordinates plus natural joint evidence plus causal output mediation.  
   Lens not yet used: biological/phenomenological and thermostat audit.

10. **Biological/phenomenological and thermostat audit:** added nothing new. It only reinforced that recurrence is not composition by itself and that emit autonomy cannot be inferred from untimed document text.  
    Lens not yet used: none.

**DEPLETED after 10 rounds.**

Exhausted lenses: causal topology, representation symmetry, natural learning, identifiability, form, memorization, scale, statistical power, IIT/exclusion, governance, information theory, biological plausibility, phenomenology, and thermostat controls.

# A. The engine

Call it a **shared-coordinate causal-core engine**.

Its defining property is not a new binding operator. It is that content appearing in different roles is never encoded in independent content spaces in the first place.

```text
                         ordinary natural bytes
                                  |
                                  v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | ONE shared content basis  |
                    | E_shared for every span   |
                    +-------------+-------------+
                                  |
                                  v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | long-context causal fabric|
                    |                           |
                    | c_i = shared content      |
                    | r_i = contextual relation |
                    | same F(c_i,c_j,r_ij) for  |
                    | every ordered pair        |
                    +---------+-----------+-----+
                              |           |
                  reflex logits           | q1 ... qm
                              |           | independent channels
                              |           v
                              |   +----------------------+
                              |   | <=15 physically      |
                              |   | causal recurrent     |
                              |   | units: h_t -> h_t+1  |
                              |   | ONLY recurrent SCC   |
                              |   +----------+-----------+
                              |              |
                              |       full-rank vector gates
                              v              v
                    +---------------------------+
                    | relational decoder        |
                    | reflex + mediated residual|
                    +-------------+-------------+
                                  |
                     +------------+------------+
                     |                         |
                  byte/event                 WAIT
                                           only when
                                      natural timing exists

Learning signal: prediction of the next naturally occurring event flows through the
same path. There is no drill head, composition loss, or train-only workspace.
```

### 1. One shared content coordinate system

Every occurrence uses the same byte/subword embedding table, content projector, and relational kernel. Roles may alter how content participates, but may not select a separate content table.

A concrete constraint is:

\[
c_i = C(E_{\mathrm{shared}}(x_i),\,context)
\]

\[
r_{ij} = R(context,i,j)
\]

\[
q_{ij} = F(c_i,c_j,r_{ij})
\]

where the same \(C\) and \(F\) are used for every grammatical or discourse role. Role information can gate or transform \(c_i\), but cannot substitute an independently learned value representation.

This directly answers the role-separate-table failure. It does not assume that ordinary text will magically align two independently permutable spaces.

### 2. A genuinely long-context causal fabric

The current roughly 35-byte receptive field cannot mediate many natural instances of coreference, contrast, temporal dependence, or entity recurrence. The replacement must initially cover at least document segments—probably 4–16 KiB—and must eventually be tested at longer spans.

This is a prerequisite, not a claim that receptive field is the composition lever. Nor does it settle the contested attention/SSM/convolution question. The invariant is the shared coordinate system; alternative long-context implementations should be compared on the frozen natural DV.

### 3. Relational interaction inside the main language path

The engine needs multiplicative or conditional interaction between content states, but not a named bolt-on binder. The same relation computation must affect the ordinary decoder used for every byte.

If a relation module can be removed while the language path remains untouched, it is probably another readout lane. A valid module must be on the causal path and must earn its contribution through ordinary text prediction.

### 4. A small recurrent causal core

Use perhaps 8–12, never more than 15, physically causal units. They receive several independent relational summaries—not their mean—and return a vector that gates several decoder channels.

The core is for three things:

- maintaining relational state across events;
- supplying an independently manipulable interior;
- defining the sole recurrent candidate complex for IIT exclusion.

It is not expected to store vocabulary or the entire proposition. Most semantic content remains in the feedforward fabric. For an interior claim to survive, however, the core must causally mediate some natural relational decisions: cutting or swapping its state must selectively damage the natural interaction score.

Untrained recurrence is not the proposed composition lever. The core must learn from birth on the same natural path as the language system.

### 5. Vector interfaces everywhere

No `_hf_mean`, scalar “drive,” complementary second engine, or rank-one write field.

The core should receive \(m\) independently addressable channels and influence a decoder subspace with measured rank greater than one. Exact unit states and exact pre-decoder vectors must remain observable. Any later projection to one number is for display only and cannot be the causal interface.

### 6. Emit is independent of content clock

Internal recurrent updates must not imply a byte emission. A WAIT/commit decision must have its own degrees of freedom and its own causal path.

But plain books, reviews, or web documents do not contain unchosen opportunities to speak. Therefore:

- composition can be trained on ordinary sequential text;
- autonomous silence cannot be claimed from document text alone;
- WAIT must remain disabled or unclaimed unless training includes natural turn boundaries, timestamps, or observed response opportunities.

That is the minimum data relaxation for the emit claim. It is still natural corpus, not a synthetic drill.

### 7. Continuous operation

The same state transitions and language path operate during learning and use. There is no special inference workspace. Weights may be frozen only for the bounded interval during which the causal interior or Phi is measured.

### 8. Required anima-py flags

At minimum:

```text
--engine shared-core
--context-bytes N
--core-units N
--core-clamp SPEC
--core-swap MATCH_ID
--content-swap MATCH_ID
--role-swap MATCH_ID
--recurrent-cut
--reflex-only
--emit-independent
--natural-composition-dv MANIFEST
--phi-core-measure
```

These should select interventions, not alternate post-hoc probes.

### Difference from LANE-BUS

LANE-BUS began with a detached trunk, a content-addressed store, a drill-trained workspace, separate heads/losses, and a later pre-softmax meeting point. That makes sense as an instrument-development architecture, but not as the p9-standard engine.

The replacement differs decisively:

- no drill-trained composition head;
- no explicit slot manifest or runtime fact store;
- no separately learned role content tables;
- no claim based on the bus, gate, discharge, or vitals toy results;
- composition is learned inside the ordinary natural language path;
- all roles share their content coordinates from the first layer onward;
- the small recurrent core exists for natural causal mediation and measurable interior, not as a bolt-on composer;
- a separate evaluation panel is never included in training.
